rules.name: iicb_release_selected_training_task_to_search
rules.comment: Release only the native-selected training curriculum task to the same graph's open-process learner.

rules.name: iicb_close_ancestor_solver_training_task
rules.comment: Retain native solver completions in all curriculum arms and record stuck outcomes when P19 search is disabled.

rules.name: iicb_close_training_task_on_native_terminal_outcome
rules.comment: Record native solve, search, proposal, qualification, or budget-denial outcomes and release the curriculum scheduler for its next task.

rules.name: iip_propose_native_training_candidate
rules.comment: Track a generic native-search expression only when its source task is explicitly training data.

rules.name: iip_qualify_after_independent_native_trials
rules.comment: Require a second distinct native-verified expression trial and a finite effect absent from active/adopted processes before exact candidate approval.

rules.name: iip_qualify_after_independent_goal_composition
rules.comment: Qualify only a novel source effect whose independently-goal composition also has an effect absent from active/adopted processes.

description: P22 generic proposals and qualification receipts from native training trials; no named successor operators.
